body: Ordinary hyphenated tokens in Jira text \(e\.g\. `UTF-8`\, `SHA-1`\, `ISO-8601`\, `RFC-2119`\) are extracted as cross\-project Jira keys\, fetched as boundary nodes\, fail\, and wrongly mark a healthy crawl as `INCOMPLETE_JIRA_GRAPH` with exit code 1\.

Commit 1d478dd applied the fix\. `jiraDepthForEdge` in src\/jira\.ts now returns `null` for cross\-project edges with `via === "text"` \(`if ("via" in edge && edge.via === "text") return null;`\)\, so ordinary hyphenated tokens like UTF\-8\/SHA\-1 are no longer fetched as boundary nodes and can no longer mark the crawl INCOMPLETE\_JIRA\_GRAPH\. Same\-project text references still recurse and structured cross\-project references still fetch one hop\. This matches the suggested fix\.

The `crawlGraph` layer\-building loop lost the \"already\-fetched\" guard\, so a node linked\-to by an earlier same\-layer sibling gets re\-fetched and its BFS depth inflated beyond its true shortest\-path depth\.

Commit 24d9e7d fixed this in `src/crawl.ts` `crawlGraph`\. The layer\-building loop now includes the suggested `if (nodes.has(key)) continue;` guard \(after `pending.delete(key)`\, so pending still shrinks and there\'s no infinite loop\)\, plus a `layerKeys` Set that makes the edge guard `if (nodes.has(edge.to) || layerKeys.has(edge.to)) continue;`\, preventing an earlier sibling from re\-queuing a later same\-layer sibling at an inflated depth in the first place\. `if (!layer.length) continue;` handles all\-fetched layers\. For seed S \-\> A\,B with A \-\> B\, B stays at depth 1 and is fetched once\. Shortest\-depth lowering for genuinely\-pending nodes is preserved by the unchanged edge loop\.
